overview.name: Proshares UltraShort Ether ETF
overview.description: The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the Daily Target. In this manner, the fund seeks daily returns that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the price of ether. The fund does not directly short ether.
